kind: bounded primitive audit over current main and same-writer candidate, NOT a new registry

findings.evidence_level: SOURCE_CONFIRMED; fullscreen candidate built, native gestures NOT_TESTED
findings.finding: WebView, iframe and native video own separate input paths. Existing main has no native video-to-host gesture bridge.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing host adapter and app input bindings
findings.acceptance: Focus each surface; Escape exits actual fullscreen without stop/load; video double-click toggles once; typing in chat never invokes media shortcuts.

findings.finding: Actual mpv with candidate input file retains LEFT/RIGHT seek -5/+5, while declared application default is 10. Native wheel/right-click/q/Enter remain separate default behaviors.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing player adapter and declaration consumer
findings.acceptance: Use one declared skip preference through button, keyboard and native video; classify each remaining default intentionally; no unintended quit/next from context change.

findings.finding: Main couples fullscreen availability to active playback/control readiness. The candidate separates it and adds native exit, but needs installed blocked/loading/disconnected verification.
findings.acceptance: Escape and visible Exit work while paused/loading, source lookup pending, player disconnected and controls hidden; no recovery action reloads media.

findings.requirement: Native surface focus and accessibility handoff
findings.finding: Native video is a separate GTK/X11 surface above the WebView. A DOM focus ring or underlying dblclick handler does not prove native focus escape or accessible controls.
findings.acceptance: Tab/Shift+Tab traverse video, controls, modal and chat; focus returns to invoker; no hidden controls receive input; true mouse/touch hit tests, not DOM event dispatch only.

findings.finding: Chat prompt/busy/proposal live in a component remounted at docking changes; previous host replay loses drafts at 1024/1023 and close/reopen. Settings close ignores dirty state and opening replaces draft.
findings.acceptance: Resize/dock/hide/reopen while editing and awaiting a response; preserve the same conversation, draft and operation; provide deliberate discard rather than accidental loss.

findings.finding: DETACH changes store layout. Native host builds only main, authorizes only main and has no owned chat-window creation/focus/reopen adapter. Arbitrary new windows are correctly denied.
findings.acceptance: Undock creates one authorized native child with same conversation; close/reopen/redock preserve it; do not enable arbitrary window.open or replace the chat engine.

findings.requirement: File export completion and native save binding
findings.finding: Settings clicks a Blob download and immediately reports Exported; native host denies downloads. No saved-file completion is observed by that UI.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing settings + native file/BINS adapter owner
findings.acceptance: User-selected scoped destination; cancel/error/success distinct; read back resulting preferences file before claiming saved. Keep broad download denial until a bounded existing adapter is wired.

findings.finding: Installed desktop file validates and launcher has single-instance logic. It is not in favorites; template is untracked. Matching actual WM_CLASS and dock launch/relaunch remains unverified.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing MN-005, indexed in Movie Night #3
findings.acceptance: Match app identifier, executable, icon and actual window class; cold launch/focus existing/minimized restore/pin survive restart without duplicate instances or changing other favorites.

findings.source: desktop/src/native.rs builder; WindowFrame.jsx onGeometryChange; studio-shell/src/main.jsx openingGeometry
findings.finding: Native always opens 1280x800 with 760x540 minimum; geometry persistence callback is skipped for native. Browser geometry saving is not native restore.
findings.acceptance: Persist/restore native geometry with monitor-safe bounds and scaling; unplug monitor and reopen; distinguish native minimum from phone browser test dimensions.

findings.finding: One rejected set_movie_viewport permanently sets failed=true. Eight simulated frames produce only one attempt, with no rebind/retry path.
findings.acceptance: Bounded geometry-only retry or explicit Reconnect; observed healthy state clears error; pause/resume/load remain untouched; no unbounded retry or media restart.

findings.requirement: Media/session identity on all state-changing actions
findings.finding: Ordinary seek/skip/pause/stop omit identity; adapter accepts omission. Explicit wrong identity is rejected. Candidate track actions bind movie/episode identity but the older path remains optional and has no playback-generation token.
findings.acceptance: A control captured for A cannot seek/stop B after source or episode switch; bind exact media and session generation; stale actions have zero effect. Keep emergency host escape independent.

findings.finding: Main has wall versus full player, and close controls stops playback. Candidate mini view is within the same window, not OS picture-in-picture; repeated mode callback currently resets mini state.
findings.acceptance: Normal/fullscreen/mini/details/hidden controls do not load media; stop and quit are separate deliberate actions; preserve source, timeline, tracks and focus.

findings.finding: Main lacks audio/subtitle selection, scene markers, chapters, playback speed and output-device UI. Candidate exposes enumerated tracks only. Buffering/seeking/ended and capability-specific states are not fully projected.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing media adapter plus shared typed choice/status controls
findings.acceptance: Only observed tracks/rates/devices exposed; subtitle Off; real command/readback; no-track is not loading. Scene bookmarks retain exact movie/episode/time and persist through existing authorized data custody.

findings.finding: Resolver already ranks eligible sources by declared quality and smaller-encode preference. Candidate Quick Play selects that ordering only after explicit click. No measured bandwidth or adaptive-quality evidence exists.
findings.acceptance: Explicit click binds current title/source; stale/absent choices fail; show actual preference basis; manual selection remains; bandwidth unknown never becomes measured-safe.

findings.requirement: OS media, power, startup and recovery integration
findings.finding: No app-owned MPRIS/MediaSession binding found. Sleep/inhibition and device-loss policy are not qualified. Launcher checks process, not frontend readiness; external loopback page has no owned startup-recovery surface. mpv may independently inhibit screensaver; do not claim OS absence from source scan.
findings.acceptance: Media keys address correct session; inhibit only appropriate states; resume/device removal retains safe state; missing host/bridge offers retry without blank trapped window or media restart.

findings.requirement: Utilities, provider setup and effect capability binding
findings.finding: App settings declaration works but is not the full OS catalogue. Managed account/functions/entities explicitly throw STUDIO_SERVICE_UNBOUND. BINS/cloud imports and OAuth setup cannot be inferred from connector access or shell icons.
findings.owner_boundary: Existing API Glass Box/plugin Work + BINS + settings owners, no new connector lane
findings.acceptance: Cog opens full shared catalogue at app; BINS opens authorized scope; real connection test/write/readback; queued worker/connector available is not installed app binding. Preserve existing Work and return route.

source_effects: No application, service, favorites, credentials or user data changed by audit probes; one private idle mpv fixture used and stopped.
